experiment: Input-only zero ablation of L3-T1372 on two child spelling prompts

features.label: Token "child" in personal or familial contexts

gate_method: raw = standardized pre_norm residual dot encoder row + bias; g = raw if raw > released theta and raw > 0, else 0.
native_computation: Native model retained. Subtract the selected estimated MOLT contribution only at the input child token, in layer 3 native raw MLP output. All other layer-3 positions remain byte-identical at the intervention boundary. Attention remains unfrozen.
timing: A gate at output token CH is measured while processing that already emitted token. The prompt-final position predicts the first answer token. Both are recorded.
resource: Reuse retained SPAR instance 56698356; separate directory and process; no new rental or lifecycle changes.
scope: Two exact existing prompts and fixed source input position 27. No answer token edits, no other layers, no strength search, and no output-word ablation. Regenerated child tokens are observed but unmodified.
intervention: native_MLP_output[child] -= removal_fraction * natural_gate(feature, child) * ((z_child @ V_feature) @ U_feature) * output_std_3; z_child is residual after attention 3, before native post-attention normalization, standardized with released MOLT statistics. FP32 delta; cast edited output to BF16.
scoring: Compare full native greedy answers. Separately teacher-force the saved baseline continuation for each condition to compare identical-prefix log probabilities. In lowercase the baseline continuation echoes child; that generated word is unedited.
controls: Unhooked native reproduces saved baseline; zero-strength hook and inactive CH-feature ablation reproduce native tokens. These are implementation sanity checks, not active norm-matched specificity controls.
limits: Subtraction removes an estimated component from the native MLP while preserving its other computation, including its reconstruction remainder. No full MOLT replacement or claim of complete task necessity. No matched active controls or CH-probe component tests in this pilot.
